records.symptom: Motion validation failed because independently rendered image pixels were treated as pose identity after otherwise successful task validation.
records.root_cause: Rendered-image equality is not a stable invariant for animation pose; lighting/AA/render initialization can differ while final skeleton transforms remain equivalent.
records.causal_repair: Compare final Skeleton3D transforms/contact state after controlled warm-up; preserve frame hashes only for provenance.
protected_files: approved upstream animation clips unless transform evidence disproves them
proof: pose-space transform limits pass
pixel equality/RMSE is rejected as a pose gate
upstream regression/performance remain green
records.prevention_rule: Motion gates use pose/contact space for motion identity and image hashes only for provenance.

records.symptom: A supposedly fixed t=0 pose drifted substantially during settle frames.
records.root_cause: The capture harness sought t=0 while leaving AnimationPlayer running, so real-time settle frames advanced the clip and invalidated the explicit sample.
records.causal_repair: Freeze animation clock during sampled-pose settling while still allowing SkeletonModifier convergence.
proof: unchanged pose thresholds pass
capture metadata proves frozen-clock sampling
full task regression remains green
records.prevention_rule: Sampled-pose harnesses separate animation time from modifier convergence time.

records.symptom: A task candidate was rejected because newly added governance/control-plane files were not included in QA-GOV ownership.
records.root_cause: Governance ownership metadata lagged behind the control-plane file set.
records.causal_repair: Add the control-plane files to @ownership:QA-GOV and reproduce integration-scope validation without changing task runtime.
proof: integration-scope validation passes
runtime diff remains unchanged
records.prevention_rule: Every new control-plane authority is governance-owned in the same architecture change set.

records.symptom: A task workflow resolved the reusable C0 workflow but failed before creating jobs.
records.root_cause: Reusable workflows cannot elevate GITHUB_TOKEN permissions above the caller; the caller omitted actions: read required to retrieve failed-run evidence.
records.causal_repair: Grant the minimal read-only actions permission at the caller and enforce the caller permission contract in source validation.
proof: workflow creates jobs
C0 evidence retrieval succeeds
no write permission is added
records.prevention_rule: Reusable workflow caller permissions are validated statically before task CI is considered ready.

records.symptom: Related failures on T10 accumulated as many serial blocker IDs instead of being forced into a bounded causal family early.
records.root_cause: Repair routing allowed symptom-level continuation after multiple failures on one candidate, increasing branch/retest churn and delaying terminal closeout.
records.causal_repair: After three distinct blockers on one frozen candidate, stop candidate churn, reconcile the complete blocker set into causal families, and require one bounded family repair plan before another build.
protected_files: unchanged approved gameplay outside the confirmed causal family
proof: family reconciliation names every known blocker
duplicate symptoms do not create new repair work
one bounded candidate verifies the whole family
records.prevention_rule: V3.2 three-blocker causal-family trigger is mandatory for T11+.

records.symptom: Independent C3/C4 review could exhaust its output budget with repetitive prose and return incomplete scored JSON even though the underlying evidence package was otherwise usable.
records.root_cause: The task evidence bounded group count but did not sufficiently bound response verbosity/output shape before expensive review.
records.causal_repair: Preflight the critic package and bind a neutral response-format contract that preserves independent judgment while bounding observations, defects and completion size.
proof: manifest/source remains unchanged
review returns complete schema
no gameplay change is needed to resolve the evidence defect
records.prevention_rule: Critic-package preflight runs before expensive independent review; output/transport failure does not automatically reopen gameplay.

records.symptom: A failure in one critic/evidence lane risked unnecessarily reopening other valid critic results.
records.root_cause: Invalidation was broader than the evidence/source fingerprint that actually changed.
records.causal_repair: On the same frozen candidate, compare critic-specific input fingerprints and rerun only affected critics; any candidate source SHA change still requires fresh exact-source review where policy requires it.
proof: preserved critic inputs are byte/fingerprint identical
changed critic inputs rerun fresh
source SHA changes invalidate exact-source critic proof
records.prevention_rule: Critic-specific invalidation is default; whole-package invalidation requires a shared-input or source change.

records.symptom: Task-local records and moving integration state could present different pictures of the active T10 candidate and next action.
records.root_cause: Mutable status artifacts were consulted without first binding all authority reads to one exact integration/candidate SHA.
records.causal_repair: Use the canonical registry/dependency authority plus an exact-source resumable checkpoint; reconcile task-local records before closeout and do not infer state from stale files.
proof: registry, dependency graph, checkpoint and candidate identity agree on exact SHA
stale task-local records cannot override canonical lifecycle authority
records.prevention_rule: Every T11+ resume/closeout begins from an exact-SHA execution checkpoint and canonical registry state.

records.symptom: Evidence/transport/format failures could be mistaken for reasons to alter or broadly retest unchanged gameplay.
records.root_cause: Failure class and affected causal object were not always separated early enough from gameplay correctness.
records.causal_repair: Classify PRODUCT_DEFECT versus TOOLING/EVIDENCE/INFRASTRUCTURE first; repair only the causal layer and preserve unchanged gameplay/critic proof when source-bound fingerprints permit.
proof: failure class names the affected object
runtime diff remains unchanged for evidence-only repair
affected proof reruns clean
records.prevention_rule: Evidence/tooling/infrastructure failures never authorize gameplay changes without independent source-bound product evidence.

records.symptom: Repeatedly moving or cancelling candidate review can erase useful terminal evidence and restart expensive work.
records.root_cause: A newer repair candidate can be mistaken for permission to invalidate an already-running exact-source review.
records.causal_repair: Finish the running SHA, preserve its terminal disposition, and queue newer candidates; cancelled/superseded runs are not product judgments.
proof: one candidate reaches terminal state before replacement review
newer candidate queues instead of cancelling
superseded status is not treated as FAIL
records.prevention_rule: finish-running-SHA is mandatory for T11+ task candidate review.
